height.$description: dimension used by the input component for height (MarsUI Input_field md cell: min-height 40px; consume as min-block-size so the field can grow).

min-target.$description: dimension used by the input component for min target.
min-target.$deprecated: Nothing paints it: the field's minimum block size is its height.

padding-inline.$description: dimension used by the input component for padding inline.

gap.$description: dimension used by the input component for gap.

label-gap.$description: dimension used by the input component for label gap.

label-padding-inline.$description: dimension used by the input component for label padding inline (MarsUI Input_label row 2px inset aligning the label ink with the cell radius).

radius.$description: dimension used by the input component for radius (MarsUI Radius/component/radius_md 10px, the md Input_cell binding; component ramp so personality modes reach it).

icon-size.$description: dimension used by the input component for icon size.

font-size.$description: dimension used by the input component for font size.

font-size-touch.$description: dimension used by the input component for the text a person types under a coarse primary pointer: 16px, under which Safari on iOS zooms the page into the focused field (spec 048). The onmars type scale has no 16px step.

font-weight.$description: font weight used by the input component for font weight.

line-height.$description: dimension used by the input component for line height.

font-size.$description: dimension used by the input component for label font size (MarsUI UI/Para/medium: body_1 13px).

font-weight.$description: font weight used by the input component for label font weight.

line-height.$description: dimension used by the input component for label line height (MarsUI line_height/para 20px).

label-hint-fg.$description: color used by the input component for the label hint after the label text (spec 047: the supporting-text role, a declared a11y deviation from the MarsUI Input_label support text Text/low_em, which reads 2.8-3.13:1 on the onmars light surfaces; under more contrast it strengthens with every other supporting text).

label-hint-gap.$description: dimension used by the input component for the gap between the label text and the label hint (MarsUI Input_label: Space/xs 4px).

border-width.$description: dimension used by the input component for border width (MarsUI Input_cell stroke: 1px hairline; the border color stays ki.outline.control per the 2026-07-25 declared a11y deviation).

width.$description: dimension used by the input component for border block start width.
dimension used by the input component for border block end width.
dimension used by the input component for border inline start width.
dimension used by the input component for border inline end width.

bg.$description: color used by the input component for rest background (MarsUI Input_field rest fill Surface/s2: the fill identifies the field, not the outline).

fg.$description: color used by the input component for rest foreground.

border.$description: color used by the input component for rest border.

label-fg.$description: color used by the input component for rest label foreground (MarsUI label is Text/med_em in every non-disabled state — active and danger included; the danger signal lives in the hint).

placeholder-fg.$description: color used by the input component for rest placeholder foreground (Text/med_em — a declared a11y deviation from the MarsUI placeholder binding Text/low_em, which reads 2.66-3.13:1 on the light field fills; a placeholder is not the accessible name but it is still text, so the contrast gate holds it to 4.5:1).

bg.$description: color used by the input component for hover background (MarsUI hover = s2 + Black/3 overlay; s3 is the nearest token).

fg.$description: color used by the input component for hover foreground.

border.$description: color used by the input component for hover border.

label-fg.$description: color used by the input component for hover label foreground (MarsUI label is Text/med_em in every non-disabled state — active and danger included; the danger signal lives in the hint).

placeholder-fg.$description: color used by the input component for hover placeholder foreground (Text/med_em — a declared a11y deviation from the MarsUI placeholder binding Text/low_em, which reads 2.66-3.13:1 on the light field fills; a placeholder is not the accessible name but it is still text, so the contrast gate holds it to 4.5:1).

bg.$description: color used by the input component for focus background (MarsUI active state switches the fill to Surface/Special white / dark s2 — modeled with the scheme ladder s0).

fg.$description: color used by the input component for focus foreground.

border.$description: color used by the input component for focus border.
border.$deprecated: Nothing paints it: a focused field keeps its resting border and is marked by its focus ring.

label-fg.$description: color used by the input component for focus label foreground (MarsUI label is Text/med_em in every non-disabled state — active and danger included; the danger signal lives in the hint).

placeholder-fg.$description: color used by the input component for focus placeholder foreground (Text/med_em — a declared a11y deviation from the MarsUI placeholder binding Text/low_em, which reads 2.66-3.13:1 on the light field fills; a placeholder is not the accessible name but it is still text, so the contrast gate holds it to 4.5:1).

bg.$description: color used by the input component for disabled background.

fg.$description: color used by the input component for disabled foreground (MarsUI disabled text Text/base_em; disabled cells are exempt from the contrast sweep).

border.$description: color used by the input component for disabled border.

label-fg.$description: color used by the input component for disabled label foreground.

placeholder-fg.$description: color used by the input component for disabled placeholder foreground.

bg.$description: color used by the input component for readonly background (retires the deprecated ki.surface.raised alias; same resolved value).

fg.$description: color used by the input component for readonly foreground.

border.$description: color used by the input component for readonly border.

label-fg.$description: color used by the input component for readonly label foreground (MarsUI label is Text/med_em in every non-disabled state — active and danger included; the danger signal lives in the hint).

placeholder-fg.$description: color used by the input component for readonly placeholder foreground (Text/med_em — a declared a11y deviation from the MarsUI placeholder binding Text/low_em, which reads 2.66-3.13:1 on the light field fills; a placeholder is not the accessible name but it is still text, so the contrast gate holds it to 4.5:1).

bg.$description: color used by the input component for invalid background (MarsUI danger state keeps the white active fill; the ring and hint carry the signal).

fg.$description: color used by the input component for invalid foreground.

border.$description: color used by the input component for invalid border.

label-fg.$description: color used by the input component for invalid label foreground (MarsUI label is Text/med_em in every non-disabled state — active and danger included; the danger signal lives in the hint).

placeholder-fg.$description: color used by the input component for invalid placeholder foreground (Text/med_em — a declared a11y deviation from the MarsUI placeholder binding Text/low_em, which reads 2.66-3.13:1 on the light field fills; a placeholder is not the accessible name but it is still text, so the contrast gate holds it to 4.5:1).

ring.$description: shadow used by the input component for the persistent invalid ring (MarsUI Focus/danger: 3px danger-500 alpha spread; applied as box-shadow while :state(user-invalid)).

color.$description: color used by the input component for focus ring color.

width.$description: dimension used by the input component for focus ring width.

offset.$description: dimension used by the input component for focus ring offset.

shadow.$description: shadow used by the input component for the focus ring glow (MarsUI Focus/primary: 3px spread ring at 20% — see ki.focus.primary. specs/002-ki-button/design-extraction.md §2.5 recorded 40%, having read the alpha off the Dark canvas mode, same double mechanism as ki-button: glow plus the opaque indicator).

height.$description: dimension used by the input component for xs height (Input-cell 8016:286 xs: 24px; consumed as min-block-size, spec 050).

padding-inline.$description: dimension used by the input component for xs padding inline (Input-cell 8016:286 xs binds Space/sm, 6px).

text-padding-inline.$description: dimension used by the input component for the xs inline padding of the native control (Input-cell 8016:286 xs Text_wrap binds Space/xxs, 2px; medium uses the gap token).

radius.$description: dimension used by the input component for xs radius (Input-cell 8016:286 xs binds Radius/small-component/xs).

font-size.$description: dimension used by the input component for xs font size: caption-2 (Input-cell 8016:286 xs). Figma draws caption_1, 10px; caption_2, 12px, is the smallest text the library ships (spec 050 D7).

line-height.$description: dimension used by the input component for xs line height (caption-2, Input-cell 8016:286 xs).

icon-size.$description: dimension used by the input component for the xs icon box (Input-cell 8016:286 xs icon 14px).

label-font-size.$description: dimension used by the input component for the xs label font size: the Input-label 12021:6068 sm step, caption-2 (spec 050 D4).

label-line-height.$description: dimension used by the input component for the xs label line height (caption-2, Input-label sm; spec 050 D4).

height.$description: dimension used by the input component for sm height (Input-cell 8016:286 sm: 32px; consumed as min-block-size, spec 050).

padding-inline.$description: dimension used by the input component for sm padding inline (Input-cell 8016:286 sm binds Space/md, 8px).

text-padding-inline.$description: dimension used by the input component for the sm inline padding of the native control (Input-cell 8016:286 sm Text_wrap binds Space/xs, 4px; medium uses the gap token).

radius.$description: dimension used by the input component for sm radius (Input-cell 8016:286 sm binds Radius/small-component/sm).

font-size.$description: dimension used by the input component for sm font size: caption-2 (Input-cell 8016:286 sm).

line-height.$description: dimension used by the input component for sm line height (caption-2, Input-cell 8016:286 sm).

icon-size.$description: dimension used by the input component for the sm icon box (Input-cell 8016:286 sm icon 16px).

label-font-size.$description: dimension used by the input component for the sm label font size: the Input-label 12021:6068 sm step, caption-2 (spec 050 D4).

label-line-height.$description: dimension used by the input component for the sm label line height (caption-2, Input-label sm; spec 050 D4).

height.$description: dimension used by the input component for lg height (Input-cell 8016:286 lg: 48px; consumed as min-block-size, spec 050).

padding-inline.$description: dimension used by the input component for lg padding inline (Input-cell 8016:286 lg binds Space/xl, 12px).

text-padding-inline.$description: dimension used by the input component for the lg inline padding of the native control (Input-cell 8016:286 lg Text_wrap binds Space/xs, 4px; medium uses the gap token).

radius.$description: dimension used by the input component for lg radius (Input-cell 8016:286 lg binds Radius/small-component/lg).

font-size.$description: dimension used by the input component for lg font size: body-2 (Input-cell 8016:286 lg).

line-height.$description: dimension used by the input component for lg line height (body-2, Input-cell 8016:286 lg).

icon-size.$description: dimension used by the input component for the lg icon box (Input-cell 8016:286 lg icon 20px).

label-font-size.$description: dimension used by the input component for the lg label font size: the Input-label 12021:6068 lg step, body-2 (spec 050 D4).

label-line-height.$description: dimension used by the input component for the lg label line height (body-2, Input-label lg; spec 050 D4).

height.$description: dimension used by the input component for xl height (Input-cell 8016:286 xl: 56px; consumed as min-block-size, spec 050).

padding-inline.$description: dimension used by the input component for xl padding inline (Input-cell 8016:286 xl binds Space/2xl, 14px).

text-padding-inline.$description: dimension used by the input component for the xl inline padding of the native control (Input-cell 8016:286 xl Text_wrap binds Space/sm, 6px; medium uses the gap token).

radius.$description: dimension used by the input component for xl radius (Input-cell 8016:286 xl binds Radius/small-component/xl).

font-size.$description: dimension used by the input component for xl font size: title-2 (Input-cell 8016:286 xl).

line-height.$description: dimension used by the input component for xl line height (title-2, Input-cell 8016:286 xl).

icon-size.$description: dimension used by the input component for the xl icon box (Input-cell 8016:286 xl icon 24px).

label-font-size.$description: dimension used by the input component for the xl label font size: the Input-label 12021:6068 lg step, body-2 (spec 050 D4).

label-line-height.$description: dimension used by the input component for the xl label line height (body-2, Input-label lg; spec 050 D4).
